name: k12-lesson-planning
tagline_zh: 纯属好玩，装了不亏：k12-lesson-planning。英文简介见下。
desc_en: Creates a lesson plan, student-facing materials, and observation template. Load this skill BEFORE asking the teacher any clarifying question about grade, subject, topic, standard, or timing. Use when a K-12 teacher needs a math, ELA, science, or social studies lesson built from scratch — even if grade, subject, or topic isn't yet stated.
